Administrative boundaries from GADM

geo_gadm.Rd

Downloads (and caches) Global Administrative Areas (GADM) boundaries as an sf tibble via geodata. Level 0 is the country outline, level 1 provinces / states, and level 2 districts. Use the result as admin in plot_sites() / plot_geo(), as an overview for geo_annotation_inset(), or to clip occurrences with geo_intersection() / geo_raster_mask().

Usage

geo_gadm(
  country = "PNG",
  level = 0,
  path = NULL,
  cache_dir = NULL,
  download = TRUE,
  version = "4.1"
)

Arguments

country

ISO3 code or country name understood by geodata::gadm() (for example "PNG" or "Papua New Guinea").

level

Administrative level: 0 (country), 1 (province), or 2 (district).

path

Optional local GeoPackage / shapefile / RDS previously saved with geo_vector_write(). When set, no download is attempted.

cache_dir

Cache directory. Defaults to tools::R_user_dir("tidymapr", "cache")/gadm.

download

Download when the cache is empty? Set FALSE on CRAN or offline runners.

version

GADM version string passed to geodata (default "4.1").

Value

An sf tibble of multipolygons (class tmr_geo_sf).

Details

GADM data are free for academic and non-commercial use; redistribution of the full database (or derived commercial products) is restricted. See https://gadm.org/license.html. This package never bundles GADM files; each call downloads into a user cache (or reads path) and the download is skipped when download = FALSE (the CRAN / offline default pattern).

References

Global Administrative Areas (GADM). https://gadm.org/

See also

geo_vector_read(), geo_vector_write(), plot_sites()

Examples

# Offline: read a previously cached GeoPackage
# png <- geo_gadm("PNG", level = 1, path = "png_adm1.gpkg")
#
# Online (needs geodata + network; skipped on CRAN):
# png <- geo_gadm("PNG", level = 1)
# plot_sites(geo_example_sites("wilhelm"), lon, lat, admin = png)
